title: Search and Indexing Implementation Reference
readerIntent: Locate provider-family ownership, configuration, source contracts, and focused tests.
priorKnowledge: Understand the search-model and provider architecture.
summary: nSearch owns the family boundary, search owns provider-neutral behavior, and elastic owns Elasticsearch-specific integration.

sections.heading: Ownership
items: gFramework/nSearch: family ownership and provider selection guidance.
gFramework/nSearch/search: normalized routes, services, pipelines, models, cache, and errors.
gFramework/nSearch/elastic: Elasticsearch connection, mappings, operations, and client calls.
Owning business modules: schemas and src/search/indexes.js definitions.
Project/environment layers: provider activation and deployment configuration.
